caption: The drawing depicts a single dress presented prominently in the center of the page, rendered in soft beige and light brown tones with subtle gray accents. The dress has short, slightly flared sleeves with horizontal bands of decorative detailing near the edges, a fitted bodice with vertical gathers converging at the waist, and a full skirt with vertical folds running its length. The lower edge of the skirt and the edge of the sleeves are adorned with several horizontal bands or stripes, depicted in a slightly darker shade. Off to the upper right corner, there is a smaller, faint sketch of the same dress, presented as an outline without color or shading, showing the overall silhouette and structure. The background is plain and unadorned, and handwriting appears in the lower right corner, providing names and possibly project details.
title: Wedding Dress
